vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
移除目标身上可被强驱散的效果（含多数眩晕）
降低目标护甲
降低目标的攻击力
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
使目标短暂离开战场，期间无敌或不可被选取
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
目标无法普通攻击
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
减少目标的法力值
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
夺取目标的属性
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算

objects.subject: invoker_ghost_walk
objects.description_zh: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
objects.description_en: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes_zh: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

shard.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。
shard.en: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

objects.subject: invoker_tornado
objects.description_zh:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于雷元素等级。滞空时间取决于冰元素等级。落地伤害取决于雷元素的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。

scepter.zh: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）
scepter.en: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

objects.subject: invoker_emp
objects.description_zh: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，%delay%秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据雷元素的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得%self_mana_restore_pct%%%损毁的魔法。
objects.description_en: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
notes_zh: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。

shard.zh: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。
shard.en: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.

objects.subject: invoker_chaos_meteor
objects.description_zh: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于火元素等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于雷元素的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于火元素的等级。
objects.description_en: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.
notes_zh: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为%damage_interval%秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续%burn_duration%秒。

objects.subject: invoker_sun_strike
objects.description_zh: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于火元素等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
objects.description_en: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes_zh: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。

scepter.zh: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。
scepter.en: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.

shard.zh: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。
shard.en: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.

objects.subject: invoker_forge_spirit
objects.description_zh: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于火元素的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于冰元素的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于冰元素和火元素中等级较低的元素。
objects.description_en: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.
notes_zh: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

objects.subject: invoker_ice_wall
objects.description_zh: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于冰元素的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，每秒伤害取决于火元素的等级。
objects.description_en: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

scepter.zh: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道%wall_width%宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过%root_delay%秒的敌方英雄会基于冰的等级被缠绕并受到魔法伤害。
scepter.en: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

objects.subject: invoker_deafening_blast
objects.description_zh: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于火元素的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于冰元素的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于雷元素的等级。
objects.description_en: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

objects.subject: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
objects.description_zh: 诅咒目标区域，造成伤害并使敌人持续受到伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。期间受到作用的英雄一旦施放魔法，持续时间就会延长。目标被沉默时不计入负面效果的持续时间。
objects.description_en: Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位也会受到作用。

objects.subject: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
objects.description_zh: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

shard.zh: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。
shard.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.

objects.subject: silencer_last_word
objects.description_zh: 向目标施加魔咒，提供目标的视野，并且只要目标施放技能或魔咒消失，目标就会受到伤害并被沉默。根据沉默术士和目标的智力差还将造成额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes_zh: 持续施法类技能在英雄结束施法后触发此技能的效果。

objects.subject: silencer_brain_drain
objects.description_zh: 沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近%permanent_int_steal_range%范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果，沉默术士都会永久窃取其%permanent_int_steal_amount%点智力。如果敌方英雄阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取%silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount%点智力。
objects.description_en: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.  If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.

objects.subject: silencer_global_silence
objects.description_zh: 沉默术士停止一切声音，阻止地图上所有敌方英雄和单位施法。
objects.description_en: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
notes_zh: 沉默效果对隐身和减益免疫单位有效，但是期间获得减益免疫状态将移除该效果。
来自阿哈利姆神杖升级全领域静默的多个奥术诅咒不会叠加。

scepter.zh: 全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。
scepter.en: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

objects.subject: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
objects.description_zh: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
objects.description_en: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes_zh: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。

objects.subject: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
objects.description_zh: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
notes_zh: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。

shard.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。
shard.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

objects.subject: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
objects.description_zh: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得全伤害护盾，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
objects.description_en: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

scepter.zh: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于%automatic_trigger_threshold%%%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每%automatic_trigger_cd%秒只能触发一次。
scepter.en: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.

objects.subject: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
objects.description_zh: 被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。
objects.description_en: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

objects.subject: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
objects.description_zh: 释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。
objects.description_en: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

objects.subject: lycan_summon_wolves
objects.description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
objects.description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。

shard.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。
shard.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

objects.subject: lycan_howl
objects.description_zh: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。
objects.description_en: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

objects.subject: lycan_feral_impulse
objects.description_zh: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。
objects.description_en: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

objects.subject: lycan_wolf_bite
objects.description_zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得%lifesteal_percent%%%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过%lifesteal_range%就能共用吸血效果。
objects.description_en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
notes_zh: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。

objects.subject: lycan_shapeshift
objects.description_zh: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
objects.description_en: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes_zh: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。

objects.subject: brewmaster_thunder_clap
objects.description_zh: 猛击地面，造成伤害并降低附近敌方单位的移动速度和攻击速度。
objects.description_en: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

objects.subject: brewmaster_cinder_brew
objects.description_zh: 向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加%extra_duration%秒，并且受到持续伤害。
objects.description_en: Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
